about_short_description.short_description: Wize is an advanced car subscription platform that provides the automobile industry with a smart, sophisticated, and up-to-date solution.

product.name: Car Subscription Platform
product.description: A platform enabling flexible car subscription services with online payments, customizable plans, and vehicle reservations via a branded client app.

product.name: Car Rental Management Solution
product.description: A digital solution for managing vehicle rentals including fleet management, damage inspection, telematics integration, and automated billing.

product.name: Motorcycles & Scooters Rental Platform
product.description: A platform supporting rental and subscription services for motorcycles and scooters, including electric two-wheelers, with fleet and payment management.

product.name: Billing and Invoicing Software
product.description: Software to automate invoice generation, payment collection, and financial reporting for vehicle subscription and rental services.

product.name: Connected Car Services
product.description: Services that monitor vehicle usage, including mileage tracking, usage area definition, and remote vehicle locking to reduce operational risks.

product.name: Customer Scoring System
product.description: A machine learning-based system that evaluates customer eligibility and verifies identity and documents to prevent fraud in vehicle subscriptions and rentals.
